def maxProfit (prices : List Nat) (h_precond : maxProfit_precond (prices)) : Nat :=
  if prices.length ≤ 1 then 0
  else
    let rec aux (l : List Nat) (min_price : Nat) (max_profit : Nat) : Nat :=
      match l with
      | [] => max_profit
      | p :: ps =>
          let new_min := min p min_price
          let new_max := max (p - new_min) max_profit
          aux ps new_min new_max
    aux prices 0 0
